_meta.notes: Per-country FX 90d change vs USD, headline CPI, child wasting/stunting. REBUILT FROM LIVE FEEDS: WFP closed its HungerMap v2 API to anonymous clients (every /v2/ path now refuses unauthenticated requests), so this is no longer a WFP mirror. fx_currency_shock = local currency fell >10% vs USD in 90d. food_inflation_pct is null by design — no live per-country FOOD inflation source exists here, and the frontend falls back to Eurostat/FAOSTAT/WB with an explicit label rather than presenting all-items CPI as food inflation. Covered 192 of 195 countries (155 FX, 155 nutrition).
